description: SMK Padungan ingin mencari team member untuk membuat software health. Kita perlu 4-6 member untuk membina satu kumpulan.
summary: AstroHealth is an application that monitors astronauts' health in real time. We developed a web app that monitors health vitals from an astronaut and sends vitals to Mission Control. Communication of Astronauts in deep space faces latency, so our solution works by establishing a WebSocket connection to Mission Control. It is important because long duration space mission in deep space take delays to communicate with Mission Control and this app gives instant alerts for crew in space missions.
details: AstroHealth is a software that monitors health of astronauts and give instant alerts. It gathers health data from health device and sends to Mission Control. The project will improve astronauts' health by sending data over a low-latency connection to Mission Control. We used web technologies and Python to develop our software. Our project is creative because it provides instant alerts when issues arises in space. Our team considers low-latency communication to ensure they can take quick action to protect astronauts in a crisis.
